LESSON 11 / 50 • ORIGINAL CHECKLIST
WHERE, ORDER BY, LIMIT
WHERE filters rows, ORDER BY sorts the result and LIMIT restricts how many rows are returned.
WHERE එJකන් අවශ්‍ය records Jතහෝරෙනවා. ORDER BY එJකන් sort කරෙනවා. LIMIT එJකන් result ගෙණන
Show the two most expensive products.
Read the column labels and compare each example row with its result.
Table එJක් columns සහ result rows එකින් එක compare කරෙන්න.
Expected result: Returns the top two qualifying products with deterministic ties.

Answer: It makes ties deterministic when paging.
